description: Agent Roles: submit a role’s review cadence with its records: the role with its id, title, version and current holder; the schedule with the cadence (monthly, quarterly, semiannual, yearly or none), the next due date and the reviewer; each review on record with its id, date, reviewer and outcome (confirmed, changed or retired); each change to the role’s work with its id, date and what changed, such as a new task, system or tool; and the date the review is read at. The signed report gives the schedule with the due date worked out and the days overdue, every review, and every change with whether it came after the last review, and counts them, and names a stale review: no cadence and no due date, no review on record, a review past due at the reading date and changes to the role’s work made after the last review while it lapsed; then no named reviewer, review by the role’s own holder, changes since a review not yet due and reviews with no outcome, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated schedule, due date, reading date, change record or holder leaves the review unverified. This reads whether one role is kept current after it is written: the review of a threshold set is wever_threshold-review-check and an onboarding record’s review date is wever_onboarding-record-check. Verdict role_review_stale, role_review_partial, role_review_unverified or role_review_current. POST /api/role-review-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.
